title: research: flash_entry() type confusion if wrong backend handle passed
description: flash_entry() in wp11_backend_usb_flash.c casts handle->priv to const wp11_key_entry_t* without verifying handle->backend == WP11_BACKEND_USB_FLASH. If the PKCS#11 layer ever routes a handle from a different backend to flash_sign/verify/decrypt (e.g. via a future refactor), the cast reinterprets arbitrary memory as a key entry. Research: verify that the PKCS#11 dispatch table guarantees backend-typed handles never cross backends. If confirmed safe, add a comment; if uncertain, add the type check as defense-in-depth.
